messages.subject: reding data from hbase using rhbase package
parts:
Hello everyone!!

I am not very experienced with HBase and I am having problems to read data from hbase table using "rhbase" package. For simple text based HBase table it is obvious how to get data, but what to do when one having composite row key? Is there any more detailed documentation or manual in addition to https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki/rhbase.

Thank you in advance, Harutyun.

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#848] reding data from hbase using rhbase package
parts:
Hi,
hbase has no composite key concept. It's just a byte array and so it is in hbase. Every other semantics is layered on by the application, as such it seems out of scope for our documentation. 


Antonio
